title: Remote work policy
text: Employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week. Requests go to the employee's direct manager.

title: Remote work policy (2025 update)
text: This update replaces the 2023 remote work policy. Employees may now work remotely up to 3 days per week. Fully remote arrangements need approval from the VP of People, Ingrid Solberg.

title: Parental leave
text: All parents receive 18 weeks of paid parental leave, which can be taken at any time within the first 12 months after a birth or adoption.

title: Travel expenses
text: Hotel costs are reimbursed up to 180 USD per night. The daily meal allowance (per diem) is 55 USD.

title: Travel expenses (2024 revision)
text: This revision replaces the 2022 travel expenses policy. Hotel costs are reimbursed up to 210 USD per night, and the daily meal allowance (per diem) is 65 USD.

title: Home office budget
text: New hires receive a one-time home office budget of 1,500 USD, to be spent within 90 days of their start date.

title: Learning stipend
text: Every employee has a learning stipend of 2,000 USD per year for courses, books and conferences. Unused stipend does not carry over to the next year.

title: Password and access security
text: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long. Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for every account. Passwords are changed only after a suspected compromise, not on a schedule.

title: On-call compensation
text: Engineers on call receive 300 USD per on-call week. A week that includes a page between midnight and 6 am also earns one extra day off.

title: Holiday calendar 2026
text: Tessaly observes 11 company holidays in 2026. The offices close for the year-end shutdown from December 24 to January 1.

title: Kestrel pipette specifications
text: The Kestrel is a single-channel electronic pipette for volumes from 0.5 to 10 microliters. Accuracy: plus or minus 0.8%. Weight: 92 grams. Warranty: 2 years.

title: Kestrel Max pipette specifications
text: The Kestrel Max is a single-channel electronic pipette for volumes from 10 to 1000 microliters. Accuracy: plus or minus 0.6%. Weight: 118 grams. Warranty: 3 years.

title: Osprey centrifuge specifications
text: The Osprey is a benchtop centrifuge with a maximum speed of 15,000 rpm and room for 24 tubes. Noise level: 52 dB. List price: 4,800 USD.

title: Osprey Mini centrifuge specifications
text: The Osprey Mini is a compact centrifuge with a maximum speed of 6,000 rpm and room for 8 tubes. Noise level: 45 dB. List price: 1,250 USD.

title: Kestrel calibration guide
text: Calibrate every Kestrel pipette every 6 months, using distilled water at 20 degrees Celsius. Use calibration kit part number KC-220.

title: Osprey maintenance guide
text: Replace the Osprey rotor seal every 2,000 hours of use. Clean the chamber weekly with a 70% ethanol solution.

title: Osprey error codes
text: E14: the lid is not latched. E21: the rotor is imbalanced; redistribute the tubes. E35: the motor is overheating; let the centrifuge cool down for 30 minutes.

title: Kestrel Max firmware 3.2 release notes
text: Firmware 3.2 adds a reverse pipetting mode and fixes a battery drain bug. Installing it requires firmware 3.0 or later.

title: Kestrel Max firmware 3.4 release notes
text: Firmware 3.4 adds a multi-dispense mode with up to 12 dispenses per aspiration. Battery life rises to 14 hours, from 10 hours in earlier firmware.

title: Returns policy
text: Hardware can be returned within 30 days of purchase for a full refund. From day 31 to day 60 a 15% restocking fee applies. No returns are accepted after day 60.

title: Price list 2025
text: List prices: Kestrel pipette 340 USD; Kestrel Max pipette 520 USD.

title: Price update January 2026
text: From January 2026 the Kestrel Max list price rises to 560 USD. The Kestrel price is unchanged.

title: Leadership team
text: Chief Executive Officer: Mara Lindqvist. Chief Technology Officer: Daniel Okafor. VP of People: Ingrid Solberg. Head of Support: Tomás Herrera.

title: Offices
text: Tessaly's headquarters are in Lisbon. The engineering office is in Tallinn and the customer support center is in Montevideo.

title: Support hours
text: The support center is open from 08:00 to 20:00 Montevideo time, Monday to Saturday. Premium customers also have a 24/7 phone line.

title: Company history
text: Tessaly was founded in Porto in 2014 and launched its first product, the Kestrel pipette, in 2016. The headquarters moved to Lisbon in 2019.

title: Customer satisfaction report 2025
text: In 2025 Tessaly's net promoter score was 47, and the median first response time to a support ticket was 3.2 hours.

title: Shipping
text: Orders ship from the Rotterdam warehouse. Standard delivery within the EU takes 5 business days; express delivery takes 2.
